Climate Week Summit Highlights Energy Transition Challenges

Climate Week has issued warnings about the difficulties in achieving the energy transition. Discussions at the summit, including panels on climate infrastructure, the climate economy, and the gas reset, focused on the challenges of building a sustainable transition, particularly in the context of a hotter world and tighter budgets. The World Wildlife Fund has also commented on the 2026 test for climate action.
